components.css: .ds-references{font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 22px}.ds-references a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;color:var(--focus,#476542);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:#a8b39d;text-underline-offset:5px;line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease}.ds-references a:hover{color:var(--ink,#252c29);text-decoration-color:var(--ink,#252c29)}.ds-references a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#476542);outline-offset:5px}.ds-references svg{flex-shrink:0;transform:rotate(-45deg)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-references{gap:10px 18px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-references a{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: A Times New Roman research presentation with a text-only title, open reading surfaces, fully wrapping chapter labels, and attached evidence links. Flowcharts are deferred; the favicon is an abstract color blob.
keyCharacteristics: Text-only header and abstract color-blob favicon.
Fully visible chapter labels at desktop and mobile widths.
Linked evidence and explicit pending results.

rules.name: Decision Accent
rules.body: Use the forest-and-lime pairing for the decision node and selected routing actions; keep reading surfaces on paper.

rules.name: Editorial Hierarchy
rules.body: Use Times New Roman for research titles and selected section headings; use Times New Roman for explanatory text, navigation, and controls.

rules.name: Flat Reading Surface
rules.body: Separate content with spacing, hairline rules, and tonal fills; the implementation uses no box shadows.

dos: Do preserve the paper, ink, forest, and lime roles defined by the frontmatter.
Do keep chapter navigation, current position, and previous/next controls clear.
Do distinguish pending evidence from supplied findings using explicit status text.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do let the mobile chapter index scroll horizontally while page content remains within the viewport.
donts: Don't add invented result values or treat the empty-chart illustration as measured data.
Don't repeat the current chapter name as an eyebrow above its title.
Don't replace the open, rule-separated composition with a generic shadowed-card grid.
Don't infer additional approved aesthetic preferences from this observed implementation.
